method: Actual current durable PNG opened separately at original resolution. Counted visible cell rows/columns, not crop margin.

groups.facts: Left subfigure: upright rectangular ABCD body on a fixed hatched horizontal base. A bottom-left, B top-left, C top-right, D bottom-right. Exactly SIX columns and FIVE rows: seven vertical boundary/grid lines and six horizontal boundary/grid lines. First internal horizontal row is labeled a at left and b at right; second is c at left and d at right.

Right subfigure: corresponding parallelogram grid sheared right at the top, with A and D still on the same fixed base. B/C move right relative to A/D. Again SIX columns and FIVE rows, with seven parallel slanted boundary/grid lines and six horizontal boundary/grid lines. Labels A/B/C/D and internal a/b/c/d remain attached to corresponding source rows and edges. Two solid vertical reference guides run upward from the base A and D positions; they are not additional cell-column lines.
groups.nativePlan: Use deterministic segments for the sheared lattice with executable indexed6x5 reconciliation and native parallel/displacement assertions; do not substitute a visible rectangular grid or expose construction anchors.

groups.facts: One separate horizontal loading cap sits above the right/sheared grid. One vector F arrow points right from its right end. Angle alpha is marked between the left original vertical reference and the sheared left boundary; a small curved directional angle mark is visible near that reference, not an extra force. A continuous hatched horizontal support runs under both subfigures. Printed subfigure marks are a-like and Cyrillic б.
